text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is this today's training regimen? How interesting…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Come now, enough with your games. This can't be the real plan, can it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I know you must still be hiding some magnificent scheme that you sacrificed everything to develop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, it seems like I still have a ways to go!
